behavior: thread/resume records its positive native acknowledgement before session capture and continuation readback; a later local not_sent or generic failure becomes unknown and marks that thread uncertain.
Existing unknown errors retain their specific code and details; true native pre-write rejection stays not_sent. Snapshot and protocol budgets remain unchanged.

The regression uses a complete schema-valid native resume response with 4000 short instruction paths, exceeding the real 256KiB SessionSnapshots budget but below the native frame limit. It checks that no second native resume is dispatched.
Controls cover successful snapshot/continuation, pre-write rejection, and preserving activity_unknown from failed continuation readback.
